title: Affective-CARA: A Knowledge Graph–Driven Framework for Culturally Adaptive Emotional Intelligence in HCI

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Kullback-Leibler divergence to measure the deviation of cultural concept representation in generated responses from a uniform distribution (cultural representation bias), and comparing emotion recognition performance (F1 scores) across five distinct cultural contexts (Western, East Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, African) to assess performance disparity.
